entities.name: PMID:35766154
observations: Normal dermal MSCs were more potent than psoriatic dermal MSCs at inhibiting CD3+ T-cell proliferation and stimulating apoptosis; normal cells also reduced Th17/Treg ratio.

entities.name: Reduced T-cell inhibition by psoriatic DMSCs
observations: In a dermal MSC/CD3+ T-cell comparison, psoriatic DMSCs showed weaker inhibition of T-cell proliferation than normal DMSCs.

entities.name: PMID:35483716
observations: Healthy normal dermal MSCs exposed to psoriatic serum failed to inhibit activated PBMC proliferation effectively; serum increased miR-155 and reduced immunoregulation-related gene expression.

entities.name: Psoriatic serum weakens DMSC suppression
observations: Exposure of normal dermal MSCs to psoriatic serum reduced their ability to inhibit activated PBMC proliferation.

relations.to: Reduced T-cell inhibition by psoriatic DMSCs
